import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def load_and_prepare_data():
    """Load and preprocess the data from input directory"""
    # Load training data
    df_train = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_train.csv", low_memory=False)

    # Create id column for training
    df_train["id"] = (
        df_train["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + df_train["token_id"].astype(str)
    )

    # Load test data
    df_test = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_test_2.csv", low_memory=False)
    df_test["id"] = (
        df_test["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + df_test["token_id"].astype(str)
    )

    return df_train, df_test


def main_solution():
    print("Loading and preparing data...")
    df_train, df_test = load_and_prepare_data()

    # Split training into train and validation sets (70/30)
    train_df, val_df = train_test_split(
        df_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=df_train["class"]
    )

    # Prepare features with class encoding
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        max_features=50000,
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=5,
        sublinear_tf=True,
    )
    X_val = vectorizer.fit_transform(val_df["before"])
    y_val = val_df["after"]

    # Class mapping
    unique_classes = sorted(set(df_train["class"]))
    class_map = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(unique_classes)}
    X_class_train = df_train["class"].map(class_map).values.reshape(-1, 1).astype(int)
    X_class_val = val_df["class"].map(class_map).values.reshape(-1, 1).astype(int)
    X_class_test = df_test["class"].map(class_map).values.reshape(-1, 1).astype(int)

    # Combine features
    X_full = np.hstack(
        [X_train.toarray() if "X_train" in locals() else X_val.toarray(), X_class_train]
    )
    X_val_combined = np.hstack([X_val.toarray(), X_class_val])
    X_test_combined = np.hstack(
        [vectorizer.transform(df_test["before"]).toarray(), X_class_test]
    )

    # Train model on training data only (validation rows excluded)
    model = LogisticRegression(random_state=42, max_iter=1000, C=0.1, solver="lbfgs")
    model.fit(X_train.toarray(), X_train.iloc[:, -1].values)

    # Predict and evaluate on validation set
    y_pred_val = model.predict(X_val_combined)
    val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val.values, y_pred_val)
    print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

    # Generate predictions for test set
    y_pred_test = model.predict(X_test_combined)

    # Create submission dataframe
    submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": df_test["id"], "after": list(y_pred_test)})

    # Save submission file
    submission_path = "./submission/submission.csv"
    submission.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
    print(f"Saved submission to {submission_path}")

    return f"{val_accuracy:.6f}"
